description: Deletes one staff event that was logged by mistake (event_id, from read a staffer's events), as Delete on the entry does. It is a hard delete and cannot be undone: re-record it with record_staff_event if it was real. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat deletes nothing more.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_staff_event
title: Delete a staff event
